item.title: image+nation 39: Montreal LGBT2SQueer Film Festival Submissions
item.description:
Organisation: image+nation culture queer

Location: Montreal, Canada (festival 19-29 November 2026). Open internationally.

Award: Screening at Canada's oldest LGBTQ+ film festival. FilmFreeway submission fee applies.

Duration: Festival 19-29 November 2026.

Deadline: 15 Sep 2026

image+nation, Canada's oldest LGBTQ+ film festival, accepts international submissions for its 39th edition in Montreal. Deadline 15 September 2026 via FilmFreeway.
